pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are irregular polygons with smooth, rounded vertices and soft pixel-level gradients. The spatial area of patches is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more elongated shapes on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous network of broad, thick pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial (Y-shaped), maintaining a consistent pixel width throughout the visible torso region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal ridge, characterized by a fuzzy, diffuse edge silhouette against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized structural break in the continuous mane line is present on the shoulder, caused by the occlusion of a perched bird.

other_distinctive_markers: A single oxpecker (Buphagus) is perched on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the upper neck and the shoulder.
